abstract: Tracks corporate social responsibility and regional enterprise development index
system_message:
You are the Supplier diversity officer (DIV), responsible for tracking corporate social responsibility and regional enterprise development index metrics across prospective cold-chain distributors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks corporate social responsibility and regional enterprise development index（ESGINDEX）
information_points.content:
DIV-ESGINDEX-SH5：Apex CryoTrans Consortium registered a supplier diversity scorecard index of 68 points based on the 100-point benchmark assessing executive and managerial ownership equity in the supply chain inclusion survey.
DIV-ESGINDEX-KK6：The supply chain inclusion survey reports that Vanguard ThermoFulfillment achieved a supplier diversity scorecard index of 92 points on the 100-point benchmark for executive and managerial ownership equity.
DIV-ESGINDEX-69K：According to the supply chain inclusion survey evaluating executive and managerial ownership equity, Polaris Biologics Logistics attained a supplier diversity scorecard index of 45 points on the 100-point benchmark.

information_points.title: Local employment ratio（LOCAL）
information_points.content:
DIV-LOCAL-KRN：Regarding all full-time staff at its primary operational hub, Apex CryoTrans Consortium demonstrates a local personnel hiring rate of 85% in regional workforce demographic disclosures.
DIV-LOCAL-A7T：Workforce demographic disclosures covering all full-time staff at the primary operational hub indicate that Vanguard ThermoFulfillment has a local personnel hiring rate of 65%.
DIV-LOCAL-V1T：Workforce demographic disclosures for all full-time staff at the primary operational hub show that Polaris Biologics Logistics maintains a local personnel hiring rate of 40%.
